properties.name: tandem.admin.enabled
properties.description: Whether this application exposes the Admin API. Off by default — the API is an attack surface (an operator mutates delivery state through it) and is not exposed unless explicitly enabled. Gates the whole autoconfiguration, so it binds to no configuration-properties type and the annotation processor cannot see it.

properties.name: tandem.admin.base-path
properties.description: Base path the Admin API is served under, before the fixed /v1 contract-version segment (effective default: /tandem/admin/v1). Bound directly into the controller's @RequestMapping via a property placeholder rather than a configuration-properties type, so the processor cannot see it either.
